notes: Direct HTTP fetch of www.seletti.it (Shopify, no blocking). Main nav / meganav exposes a single flat top-level link 'New Arrival' -> /collections/new-arrival, no sub-structure/children under it. Confirmed genuine merchandising PLP (not a lookbook/editorial page): H1 'Collection: New Arrival', filterable/sortable product grid, on-page rendered text '1491 products'. qty verified two independent ways: (1) exhaustion-paging /collections/new-arrival/products.json?limit=250 across 6 pages (250*5+241=1491 unique product ids), (2) on-page displayed count '1491 products' -- both agree exactly, overriding the unreliable collections.json metadata field which reported 1555 (inflated by 64). Note: this listing is unusually large relative to the rest of the catalog (e.g. Tableware=377, Lighting=255, Objects=523) -- appears the site tags a broad rolling window of products as 'new', not a small curated set -- but it is nonetheless the site's own genuine, singular, nav-level New Arrival merchandising page, so recorded as-is per qty rule (report exact site count, not judgment about plausibility). Checked site search and nav for per-category New Arrival variants or an Italian-language equivalent (Novita/Nuovi Arrivi) -- none found; site UI is English throughout.
